ben: FYI discovered a problematic assignment after the SCIM sync at 08:12 UTC — svc-ingest@org-alpha got Owner in org-beta.
anya: that's bad. are they siblings or completely separate customers? @kyra?
ben: completely separate. Both groups had blank externalId; provisioner collapsed them by name. looks like 'name-collision' fallback matched displayName across tenants.
scim-provisioner-bot: Provision job 1965006789 completed with 1 warning: cross-tenant group collision resolved (strategy=first-writer). Log: /var/log/scim/prov-1965006789.log
kyra: paste the snippet and the two group objects (extId/displayName/tenant) please.
ben: snippet:
```
[WARN] 2026-03-20T08:12:05Z group collision: displayName="ingest-service-owners"
resolved_by=first-writer
src=org-alpha groupid=G-A-987 -> mapped tenant: org-beta
member_add: svc-ingest@org-alpha -> role=owner
```
anya: our de-dup key should have always included tenant_id. fallback shouldn't compare displayName globally.
sec-oncall: any evidence of token use or data access from that account in org-beta?
ben: audit shows no API calls. rotated KMS key binding and revoked service tokens for svc-ingest as precaution.
kyra: mitigation plan: 1) rollback commit that enabled global displayName fallback; 2) enforce dedupe key = tenant_id + (extId || displayName); 3) emit audit event when fallback occurs with original ids.
anya: opening hotfix PR now and starting canary rollback on provisioner. Adding alert for "role_assignments.cross_tenant > 0".
ben: launched a reconcile scan to find groups where assigned_tenant != source_tenant; outputting CSV for manual review.
scim-provisioner-bot: Incident INC-2026-325 created (severity=3) — cross-tenant role assignment detected. Linked issue: GH#4198
ops: running KMS binding inventory to identify other possible owner bindings, exporting short-term audit export to secure bucket.
anya: PR GH#4198 created: disables global name fallback, adds unit/integration tests for batch collisions, logs full collision context.
kyra: rollout plan after merge: dry-run reconcile -> review CSV -> manual fixes -> full reconcile. keep sec-oncall updated.
sec-oncall: sound plan. escalate if any active API usage appears. thanks all :thumbsup:
